query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_vendas,
  SUM(finalAmount) as valor_total
FROM sales 
WHERE saleType = 'DELIVERY'
  AND YEAR(saleDate) = 2025
  AND MONTH(saleDate) = 12
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
